chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Keep walking in your sickness as long as you can.

key_terms.مَا: as long as / to the extent that

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic guidance on physical activity during illness?
ai.summary: In Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises maintaining mobility during illness to prevent the stagnation of the body and mind, reflecting the Shia emphasis on balancing physical care with spiritual resilience. This guidance underscores the principle of *'amal* (action) even in weakness, encouraging believers to utilize their remaining strength for worship and daily duties rather than succumbing to passive confinement. It serves as a practical reminder that health is a trust (*amanah*) to be preserved through moderate activity.
